optimizations_identified.title: REST Gateway Single-Attempt Timeout Resilience
optimizations_identified.description: Transient network hiccups on REST/WS liquidity endpoints can fail order transmission without immediate retry backoff.
optimizations_identified.remediation: Implement exponential retry backoff (2 attempts) in UniversalBrokerGateway.execute_order for REST/WS routes.

round_goal: Harden UniversalBrokerGateway REST execution resilience, produce documentation, and verify 100% test green status.
